messages:
Carla (Partner): hey team — partner asked to kick off a shared POC w/ their connector next Wed. can we confirm network + SSO requirements? they need an integration checklist and POC timeline.
Ben (Sales): thanks Carla. priority is to get pricing ballpark for 2-week POC (dedicated mod) and a short runbook we can hand to their infra. any blockers on our side?
Alice (Prod Eng): +1 on checklist. quick notes: for Redwood Private we need either VPC peering or privateLink; if they want on-prem, we provide the package but need fw rules and node specs. typical ports: 443 outbound for API, 10250 for kube (if on-prem k8s ops), 50051 if using grpc gateway.
Derek (Solutions): FYI partner will stream ~50 concurrent sessions at peak, typical sequence length ~512. suggested config: reserved small cluster (4xA100) for the POC, batching window 25ms to hit latency targets.
Carla (Partner): they asked about SSO — can we do SAML SSO w/ their IdP? also need an IP allowlist and cert rotation details for the integration team.
Alice (Prod Eng): we support SAML + OIDC. for SAML we need the metadata file and ACS URL from their IdP. cert rotation: we publish key rollover docs and support automated KMS/HSM rotation if they have a customer-managed key. I can draft the minimal SAML attributes we need.
Ben (Sales): pricing question: if we put them on a short reserved capacity for 2 weeks, do we prorate? what's the minimum commit? and any trial credits we can give them to offset infra while they test?
Derek (Solutions): pragmatic approach — quote a small reserved cluster daily rate and mark as prorated for <=30 days. I'll work with finance for an internal list price. for now, estimate: 4xA100 eq ~ $Xk/day (placeholder).
Carla (Partner): also their security team sent over an initial questionnaire (DOCX). highlights: data residency, encryption at transit+rest, retention policy, and model weights provenance. who on our side handles the questionnaire?
compliance-bot: SOC2 and ISO docs available at https://redwood.example.com/compliance. Link token (expiring): https://redwood.example.com/s/abc123 (expires 72h)
Alice (Prod Eng): I can take the technical sections (encryption, keys, cert rotation, network). @compliance-bot link looks good; Derek can handle retention & data flows. Ben will own commercial Qs.
Ben (Sales): agreed. I also need a short blurb about fallback/failover behavior for the POC in case one of the partner's endpoints flaps — partner wants SLA-ish guarantees.
Derek (Solutions): propose automatic fallback to hosted Redwood model variant in another region, with transparent routing. for the POC we can set a simpler failover (regional backup) and document expected RTO/RPO (not formal SLA).
Carla (Partner): blocker: their legal insists on a redlined NDA/MAA clause for subprocessor list and audit rights before we share host-level logs. can we get a list of subprocessors and a sample redwood MAA?
Alice (Prod Eng): subprocessors list is maintained by legal; I'll ping legal and paste a trimmed list. logs: we can provide request-level telemetry but not full system internals; will need legal approval for audit clauses.
Ben (Sales): timeline ask from partner: must start POC by next Wed (7 days). is that feasible?
Derek (Solutions): tight but doable if partner provides SAML metadata + network contacts within 48h and approves the quoted temporary cluster. onboarding runbook:
```
1) Share SAML metadata + IP block list
2) Setup VPC peering / PrivateLink
3) Apply certs & KMS config
4) Deploy POC stack & smoke tests (curl + sample payload)
5) Monitor perf for 48h, iterate
```
Alice (Prod Eng): sample smoke test curl (for their infra team):
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDBWOOD_POC_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"hello"}' \
  https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/generate
```
Carla (Partner): can you add a short network checklist with exact ports and CIDRs? their infra will not accept vague docs.
Alice (Prod Eng): will do — include explicit CIDR ranges for peering and ephemeral ports used by the runtime. also note egress to model hub (if using open weights) may be required during setup.
compliance-bot: note: retention defaults: 30 days for request logs; can be shortened per enterprise contract. encryption: TLS1.2+ in transit; AES-256 at rest.
Ben (Sales): blocker: partner asked for an enterprise quote w/ SSO + private deployment + extra retention; need to know if we can offer a 30-day trial discount or reduced min commit for channel deals. legal also wants to limit liability for third-party infra issues.
Derek (Solutions): I'll draft two options: 1) short reserved trial (2 weeks) w/ prorated pricing and limited liability, 2) standard 3mo pilot w/ regular pricing and support. Will tag finance + legal.
Carla (Partner): ok last Q — can we get a single point of contact for technical onboarding (email + slack)? their PM prefers a single thread.
Alice (Prod Eng): I'm happy to be the tech POC for the onboarding + SAML work: alice@redwood.example.com; Slack: @alice. Derek will be the solutions POC for config + pricing: derek@redwood.example.com; @derek. Ben will own commercial: ben@redwood.example.com.
Ben (Sales): next actions: Derek to send preliminary quote by EOD today; Alice to post network checklist + SAML attribute list in this thread by tomorrow morning; partner to provide SAML metadata + infra contact within 48h.
Carla (Partner): I'll confirm internally and share metadata + contact. appreciate the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
Derek (Solutions): noted — filing tasks now. adding: test plan for perf measured at p50/p95 latencies and token throughput.
Alice (Prod Eng): will include perf targets and sample telemetry dashboard links in the runbook.
Carla (Partner): thanks all — will loop legal once we get subprocessor list.
Ben (Sales): good sync. looping in legal/finance on the quote.
compliance-bot: audit dp: request submitted to legal for subprocessors list; expect reply 48-72h.
